title.en: An Act to Reclassify a Portion of the Land Under Cadastral Survey 800-D, Module 2, Project No. 1-LC Map 203 in Barangay Santa Monica, Puerto Princesa City, Province of Palawan as Agricultural Land Open to Disposition
title.orig: An Act to Reclassify a Portion of the Land Under Cadastral Survey 800-D, Module 2, Project No. 1-LC Map 203 in Barangay Santa Monica, Puerto Princesa City, Province of Palawan as Agricultural Land Open to Disposition

text.en: That portion of the territory of Barangay Sta. Monica in the City of Puerto Princesa, Province of Palawan, consisting of nine hundred eighty-two hectares and five thousand six hundred sixty centares of land under cadastral survey 800-D, module 2, classified as timber land under Project No. 1-LC Map 203, is hereby reclassified as agricultural land, open to disposition, except that portion covered by Presidential Proclamation No. 16, dated September 11, 1998.
The Secretary of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources shall issue all the necessary orders, rules and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
